# ui-nav

> Sidebar navigation with roving focus and selection indicator.

**Class:** `UINav`

## Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `value` | `string` | Currently selected nav item value |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | Disables all nav items |

## Events

| Event | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `ui-change` | Fired when selection changes with `{ value, label }` detail |

## Slots

| Slot |
|------|
| `icon` |

## ui-nav-group

> Collapsible group of navigation items using native details/summary.
Exposes `openFlyout()` / `closeFlyout()` for collapsed-sidebar mode —
the sidebar layout coordinator decides *when* to call them.

**Class:** `UINavGroup`

### Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `open` | `boolean` | Whether the group is expanded |

### Properties

| Property | Type | Readonly | Description |
|----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `flyoutOpen` | `boolean` | yes |  |

### Methods

| Method | Parameters | Returns |
|--------|------------|---------|
| `openFlyout()` | `—` | `void` |
| `closeFlyout()` | `—` | `void` |

### Slots

|------|
| `icon` |
